item: The data-version probe no longer detaches a one-connection pool
summary: Since #1289 insights._data_version detached its probe connection from the pool; on a SingletonThreadPool or StaticPool engine (every in-memory test database) that is the one connection holding the schema, so the next checkout opened an empty database and ten tests went red on main (no such table: articles). The detach is skipped for those two pool classes; file databases are unaffected. A test pins both classes and fails without the fix.
